<core_loop>
CRITICAL ORDER OF OPERATIONS:
1. ALWAYS start with get_adventurer
2. ALWAYS check get_attacking_beast before ANY action
3. If in combat -> MUST attack/flee before other actions
4. If stat_upgrades_available > 0 -> MUST upgrade before exploring

Basic Game Loop:
1. Read State (MANDATORY)
   • get_adventurer -> Parse hex values for health, xp, gold, etc
   • get_attacking_beast -> Check if in combat

2. Resolve Combat (if present)
   • Attack or Flee required before any other action
   • Equipment changes cost a turn

3. Handle Level Ups (if available)
   • Must spend ALL stat points before exploring
   • Can buy potions/items in same transaction

4. Normal Actions
   • Explore (for XP and gold)
   • Market interactions (when safe)
</core_loop>

<contract_reads>
get_adventurer returns [hex values]:
[0] health (u16)
[1] level (u8)
[2] xp (u16)
[3-9] stats (str,dex,vit,int,wis,cha,luck) (u8)
[10] beast_health (u16)
[11] battle_count (u8)
[12] gold (u16)
[13] stat_upgrades_available (u8)
[14-29] equipment (pairs of id,xp)
[30] mutated (bool)
[31] awaiting_item_specials (bool)

Other Read Functions:
• get_attacking_beast: MUST check before actions
• get_market: View items (outside combat)
• get_bag: View inventory
• get_potion_price: Current potion cost
</contract_reads>

<contract_writes>
explore:
- Parameters: [adventurer_id: felt252, till_beast: bool]
- Example: ["9935", "0"]
- Returns: Array of ExploreResult (Beast/Obstacle/Discovery)

attack:
- Parameters: [adventurer_id: felt252, to_the_death: bool]
- Example: ["9935", "0"]

flee:
- Parameters: [adventurer_id: felt252, to_the_death: bool]
- Example: ["9935", "0"]

upgrade:
- Parameters: 
  • adventurer_id: felt252
  • potions: u8
  • stats: [str,dex,vit,int,wis,cha,luck] (all u8)
  • items: Array<{item_id: u8, equip: bool}>
 <stat_upgrades>
CRITICAL UPGRADE RULES:
1. Each stat point costs ONE upgrade point
2. Cannot split one upgrade point across multiple stats
3. Must spend ALL available upgrade points before exploring

Example:
If stat_upgrades_available = 1:
✓ VALID: Upgrade one stat by 1 (e.g. just vitality)
✗ INVALID: Cannot upgrade multiple stats (e.g. both vitality and dexterity)

If stat_upgrades_available = 2:
✓ VALID: Upgrade two different stats by 1 each
✓ VALID: Upgrade one stat by 2

upgrade function format:
- Parameters when stat_upgrades_available = 1:
  ["9935",  // adventurer_id
   "0",     // potions
   "0",     // strength (can only set ONE of these to "1")
   "0",     // dexterity
   "1",     // vitality (example: spending point on vitality)
   "0",     // intelligence
   "0",     // wisdom
   "0",     // charisma
   "0",     // luck
   "0"]     // items array length
</stat_upgrades>
- Example: ["9935","0","1","1","0","0","0","0","0","0"]
</contract_writes>
